title: First run B: terms + the setup wizard
description: Segment B of the first-run video: accept the Terms of Use, then make every setup-wizard choice with the reason behind it, skip the tour, land on Home. Starts at the Terms window (the app has just been signed in after licensing). Record the whole video with: python record.py scripts\first-run-b-setup-wizard.json --as-is --licence-intro scripts\first-run-a-account-licence.json  ({{OUTPUT}} is substituted by record.py).

steps.narration: The Terms of Use come next. Read them, tick to accept,
steps.caption: Terms of Use — read, then accept

steps.narration: and Continue.
steps.caption: 11. Continue

steps.narration: A short setup wizard follows. Everything here can be changed later in Settings.
steps.caption: Setup wizard — everything changeable later

steps.narration: Click Next.
steps.caption: 12. Next

steps.narration: ScanFinder needs one thing: an output folder, where the filed copies of your documents go, organised by company, year and month. A sensible location is already suggested.
steps.caption: Output folder — where filed copies go

steps.narration: If you'd rather file somewhere else — a shared drive, say — click Browse and pick that folder. We'll keep the suggestion.
steps.caption: 13. Browse — only if you want a different folder

steps.narration: Below, choose where original scans go after import. Default moves each into a Processed folder beside your scans; Choose a folder sends them to an archive of your choosing. Nothing is ever deleted.
steps.caption: Originals: moved to Processed, never deleted

steps.narration: Default is right for most people.
steps.caption: 14. Keep Default

steps.narration: Next.
steps.caption: 15. Next

steps.narration: This screen sets how filed documents are organised: folders by issuer, then year, then month; files named by type, date and reference. Rearrange the blocks if you prefer another layout.
steps.caption: Folders: Issuer › Year › Month · File: Type.Date.Ref

steps.narration: The preview shows a real filed path.
steps.caption: Preview = a real filed path

steps.narration: Regional format tells ScanFinder how your documents write dates and amounts — day-month-year in the UK, month-day-year in the US — so the 3rd of April isn't read as the 4th of March.
steps.caption: Regional format — how YOUR documents write dates

steps.narration: Next.
steps.caption: 18. Next

steps.narration: Pick a theme — Light or Dark; you can switch any time.
steps.caption: Theme — switch any time

steps.narration: Next.
steps.caption: 19. Next

steps.narration: Speed sets how many documents are read at once. Balanced suits most machines, Fast is for a powerful PC, Gentle keeps the computer responsive during big batches.
steps.caption: Speed = how many documents are read at once

steps.narration: Balanced is a safe choice.
steps.caption: 20. Balanced — safe for most PCs

steps.narration: For accuracy, keep Thorough — the recommended setting; the time difference is small.
steps.caption: 21. Thorough — best accuracy

steps.narration: Next.
steps.caption: 22. Next

steps.narration: Diagnostics stay off unless you turn them on — and even then only app errors and version numbers are shared, never documents. No thanks is fine.
steps.caption: Diagnostics — off unless you say so

steps.narration: Next.
steps.caption: 23. Next

steps.narration: Setup is complete — click Finish.
steps.caption: Setup complete

steps.narration: A short tour introduces importing, reviewing and teaching. Step through it or skip it — it's always available from the user menu.
steps.caption: Welcome tour — Next through it, or Skip

steps.narration: For now, Skip.
steps.caption: 25. Skip for now

steps.narration: And here's Home. Next: import your first folder of scans.
steps.caption: Done — next: import your first scans
